note: An additive overlay that carries the ratified new fingerprint of .github/workflows/free-market-data.yml so the registry's own bytes never move. config/regime_source_owner_registry_v2.json is NOT edited: its exact bytes are hash-bound by config/crypto_paper_runtime_v1.json and config/kr_paper_runtime_ratification_candidate_v1.json (POLICY_BINDING_DRIFT at regime/crypto_paper_runtime.py and regime/kr_paper_runtime_ratification_candidate.py), and those are in turn bound by committed append-only evidence. Same separate-additional-record pattern as config/paper_runtime_normalization_v1.json, config/regime_semantic_freshness_policy_v1.json, config/us_session_calendar_source_v1.json and config/korea_five_signal_pointer_writer_v1.json. Unlike those, this overlay supersedes a pinned sha256 value, which is why it required its own user ratification.

registry_binding.reason: Measured, not assumed. Editing the registry's workflow_sha256 in place was applied end to end on a throwaway branch: nine files can absorb it (the registry, config/crypto_paper_runtime_v1.json, config/kr_paper_runtime_ratification_candidate_v1.json, config/us_session_calendar_source_v1.json, test/test_us_official_session_calendar.py, regime/crypto_paper_runtime.py POLICY_SHA256, config/crypto_candidate_promotion_contract_v3.json, universe/crypto_candidate_promotion.py CONTRACT_V3_SHA256). After all nine, the superseded policy sha256 still lives in seven retained append-only packets under evidence/regime/crypto_paper_runtime/2026-09-14..2026-09-17 and in data/latest_crypto_paper_runtime_decision.json, and the suites fail exactly there: CRYPTO_RUNTIME_DECISION_IDENTITY_MISMATCH at universe/crypto_candidate_promotion.py, and sixteen failures in test/test_crypto_paper_wiring_v2.py collapsing to PROMOTION_PACKET_UNAVAILABLE. Only rewriting policy_sha256 inside committed evidence clears them, which is forbidden. Hence this overlay.

change.step_name: Commit immutable evidence and latest pointer
change.binding_reason: No sha256 is recorded for the shared helper on purpose. Pinning its bytes here would give this overlay a fingerprint cascade of its own over a file the registry does not record, and would freeze a helper three other workflows are meant to converge on. The binding is structural instead and re-checked by test/test_free_market_data_push_retry.py: the commit step must invoke that script with the default branch, must not inline a retry loop, and the script itself must be bounded and fail-closed.
change.fail_closed: A rebase conflict aborts the rebase and returns non-zero; exhausting the attempts returns non-zero. A dropped commit is never reported as success.
